depiction.primary_object: diagonal arrow pointing up and right

readings.meaning: external link or open in new tab

ambiguity: Without a surrounding box or phone handset, a bare diagonal arrow is generic UI chrome and could mean external link, expand, export, outgoing, or upward growth.
task_intents: set links to open new tab

reasoning: A bare northeast diagonal arrow is standard UI chrome for opening an external link or expanding a view, rather than a concrete task subject. While it can loosely suggest external links, exports, or upward trends, specialized icons (chain link, export tray, trend chart, phone handset with arrow) are much clearer and less ambiguous for actual to-do items.
